subject: Database Migration — Post-Migration Report
body:
Hi team,

Happy to report that the PostgreSQL migration (NEX-189) completed successfully overnight.

Migration summary:
- Start: Nov 3, 02:05 IST
- End: Nov 3, 05:48 IST (3h 43m — under the 4h window)
- PostgreSQL upgraded from 13.12 to 16.1
- Events table partitioned by month — query performance improved ~40%
- Logical replication standby active, will remain live until Nov 6 (72 hours)
- Zero data loss confirmed via row count verification

Known issues:
- Post-migration index rebuild script had a warning on the documents.created_at column. I've opened ticket NEX-244 to investigate — see email_08 for the incident that followed.

Overall: migration successful. Thanks to Arjun (on-call primary) and Riya (backup) for being available throughout.

Diana
